glance.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
glance.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following a board investigation into multiple extramarital affairs with a direct report and an alleged Chinese spy.
glance.why: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and resigned as CEO following a board investigation.

stories.label: Open source
stories.headline: Nvidia donates OpenShell to CNCF
stories.summary: Nvidia donated OpenShell, its open-source runtime for securing and governing AI agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.

stories.label: New system
stories.headline: Google introduces TPU Sync for faster inference
stories.summary: Google announced TPU Sync, an open-source system designed to speed up AI software by cutting inference latency by over 90 percent.

concept.explanation: Inference latency refers to the time it takes for an AI model to process a request and generate a response; Google's new TPU Sync system aims to reduce this time.
